lounges.name: Emirates Business Class Lounge (Concourse B)
lounges.location: Concourse B, lounge level above departures; follow Emirates Business Class Lounge signs.

hours.note: The current Emirates pages confirm the facilities but do not publish a fixed daily opening schedule. Confirm opening for your flight.

accessRules.label: Emirates Skywards Silver, Gold or Platinum
Emirates Business Saver, Flex or Flex Plus
conditions: Confirm your fare includes lounge access; Business Special does not qualify by cabin alone.

sources.title: Emirates · Dubai lounge eligibility by fare and status

qualityRating.summary: A November 2024 visit praised the food variety and separate relaxation areas, but found the evening peak very crowded. A strong all-round option, with quieter seats away from the central food stations.

sources.title: Points Miles and Bling · Concourse B (November 2024 visit)

lounges.note: Spa treatments cost extra. Gourmet food is available; a full-service restaurant is unconfirmed. Allow time if your flight leaves from another concourse.

recommendation.summary: Showers, quiet seating and optional spa treatments for eligible Emirates travellers in Concourse B; confirm opening before relying on it.

lounges.name: Plaza Premium Lounge (Concourse A)
lounges.location: West wing, Level 4. Take the lift from duty free between Gates A2 and A3.

sources.title: Priority Pass · Plaza Premium T3 Concourse A
Plaza Premium · Dubai T3 facilities and optional services

qualityRating.summary: LoungePair’s January 2025 account describes useful private cubicles, good showers and enjoyable food, with some worn furnishings. It is a lounge-pass seller; its package inclusions differ from Priority Pass.

sources.title: LoungePair · Dubai Plaza Premium firsthand review (2025)

lounges.note: Priority Pass permits two hours. Showers, private suites and some drinks cost extra. Hot meals are available; full-service dining is unconfirmed. Allow time for any concourse transfer.

recommendation.summary: A 24-hour Priority Pass option in Concourse A, with showers available for an additional charge.
